name: r3s2_ceiling
description: Card r3s2_field_reach-B3 — the five-rung emulator-ceiling ladder. A shared FiLM-FNO trunk (w64/4 blocks/12 modes) with B1's zero-parameter analytic IC-synthesis channel drives five rungs on held-out TRAIN rows: R0_absent (matched-budget condition->HF, THE no-LF denominator), R1_predicted (the deployed pseudo-LF route through a frozen corrector), R1b_degraded (pseudo-LF lifted, corrector removed), R2_oracle (REAL LF through the SAME frozen corrector — the ceiling, NON-DEPLOYABLE under immutable #9), and R2b_copylf (real LF, convention lift only). Statistics phi_ceil / phi_real / rho / E_est / E_hall in certified film-skill units; the LSI regularisation is selected on the emulator's own held-out output (D2 instrument repair). The panel number is R1_predicted on the stripped test split.
